## Not quite your mix? There's a path either side

::: {.spectrum}
::: {.path}
[Maths not your favourite?]{.path-tag}

**Finance & Economics**

Less maths, more money, markets and policy: how assets are priced, how businesses are funded, how economies and governments decide.
:::
::: {.path .path-here}
[Today]{.path-tag}

**Actuarial Studies**

Maths and data applied to risk: insurance, superannuation and beyond.
:::
::: {.path}
[Love the theory?]{.path-tag}

**Statistics**

Go deeper into probability, data and models: the theory that actuarial work is built on.
:::
:::

::: {.spectrum-axis}
[More business & economics]{.left} [More statistical theory]{.right}
:::

::: {.fdd .fragment .zoom-in}
You can mix them too: picking electives, minors and even majors across disciplines. Want even more? **Flexible Double Degree:** combine two degrees from a wide variety of disciplines.
:::

::: {.notes}
About 1 min. Press next to pop out the Flexible Double Degree box. Reassure students who enjoyed the game but aren't sure about the maths: the same ideas show up in finance and economics with less maths. For the keen maths students, statistics goes deeper.
:::
